entries.what: Rochelle gets up early, packs leftovers in the blue cooler bag and drives the van to Tamsen Valley with the check-engine light still on, parking in Lot C by 8:15.
entries.outcome: Made it to class on time.

entries.what: In Dr. Okoye's anatomy section Rochelle sits next to Linh, still stinging from the bad quiz block, and afterward she tells Linh a C is a C, whatever. The van has been acting up all week and that is what is on her mind.
entries.outcome: Shrugged off the grade because the car worry took her whole attention, not because she has stopped caring.

entries.what: She eats lunch in the car in Lot C, then picks up DeShawn and starts dinner. After 9 she studies index cards at the kitchen table.
entries.outcome: Got through two body systems before bed.

entries.what: Rochelle goes to Intro Chemistry at 11, then spends the rest of the day on errands.
entries.outcome: Chem finished; errands lined up for the afternoon.

entries.what: At 3:30 she takes her mother-in-law Loretta to the pharmacy and a checkup, so she misses Pedro's 4 p.m. study group again.
entries.outcome: Loretta got her refills; Rochelle skipped group.

entries.what: Keisha calls on her dispatch break and again in the evening, nagging about studying. Rochelle does cards at the table after 9.
entries.outcome: Promised to catch up on the cards.

entries.what: The Pell disbursement of $1,980 lands this morning. Rochelle sits through anatomy at 9 and the Wednesday lab, then visits Dr. Okoye's office hours.
entries.outcome: Pell money arrived and she got her lab questions answered.

entries.what: Rochelle compares three refurbished laptops down to the price of the charger, working out each cost in warehouse hours before she spends any Pell money. She buys the $310 one.
entries.outcome: Bought the $310 refurbished laptop and retired Keisha's cracked-hinge hand-me-down.

entries.what: Rochelle sets up the new laptop at the kitchen table that evening and tries the portal on it.
entries.outcome: Portal logged in fine on the new battery.

entries.what: Intro Chemistry at 11 after a morning walk on the Ulloa Salt Marsh boardwalk for her back.
entries.outcome: Back loosened up for class.

entries.what: Rochelle takes the van to a Ruel Road shop to have the check-engine light looked at, and the shop says it is the transmission solenoid and wants the van for a few days.
entries.outcome: Repair booked for the next day.

entries.what: Luisa sends a warehouse gossip voice note at 11:30. In the evening Rochelle makes a plan with Keisha for rides.
entries.outcome: Rides arranged for tomorrow.

entries.what: The van goes into the shop on Ruel Road for the transmission solenoid. Keisha picks Rochelle up in the red pickup and drives her to Tamsen Valley for anatomy.
entries.outcome: Van in the shop and Rochelle got to class.

entries.what: In the afternoon Rochelle works out the repair estimate against the family budget at the kitchen table.
entries.outcome: Waiting on the final repair number.

entries.what: Rochelle packs a lunch and eats it with Keisha in the pickup, then goes over anatomy cards that evening.
entries.outcome: Reviewed a body system on cards.

entries.what: Rochelle skips her usual routine to catch up on laundry while the old hospital drama plays.
entries.outcome: Laundry done.

entries.what: She goes to Ruiz Family Market for meat, then the discount warehouse store for bulk, with Aaliyah driving.
entries.outcome: Stocked up for Sunday batch cooking.

entries.what: Rochelle works through anatomy cards at the kitchen table while Andre watches TV.
entries.outcome: Finished the muscular system cards.

entries.what: Rochelle skips the 11 a.m. Baptist church service on Pell Road for errands and batch cooking, making red beans and rice for the week.
entries.outcome: Food prepped for the week.

entries.what: Andre watches football in the afternoon and falls asleep by the second half. Aaliyah heads out to her rec soccer game at Delgado Park, where the harvest farmers market is on.
entries.outcome: Quiet afternoon at home.

entries.what: After 9 p.m. Rochelle studies at the kitchen table for the week ahead, with Keisha due to give her rides while the van is in the shop.
entries.outcome: Cards reviewed and the week planned on the fridge calendar.
